name: skills
description: Portable skills for code review, database and security audits, SOC 2 readiness, implementation, refactoring, dependency upgrades, public and private desktop releases, Vercel domain cleanup, and clear communication.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence, audit database schemas and queries, audit code and repository security, assess SOC 2 readiness with reports in chat, remove unnecessary complexity, refactor with current official docs and regression tests, upgrade dependencies with migrations and verification, and communicate clearly at the requested level of detail. Set up signed public GitHub releases with automatic updates and separate development apps, or private releases with licensed updates and device administration. Fix Vercel production and www redirects, reconcile DNS, and verify websites.
defaultPrompt: Review these changes with the code-review skill.
Assess this project with the soc2-readiness skill and report findings in chat.
Implement this with the code-build skill.
Refactor this code with current official docs and regression tests using the code-refactor skill.
Audit this repository and its GitHub Actions with the code-security skill.
Review schemas, queries, and migrations with the database-audit skill.
Update dependencies and apply required migrations with the upgrade-dependencies skill.
Explain this with the make-sense skill.
Write explanations, instructions, and reports with the simplify skill.
Set up private desktop distribution with the private-desktop-release skill.
Set up and publish this app with the public-desktop-release skill.
Fix production redirects and DNS warnings with the vercel-domain-cleanup skill.
